ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region on the lower-left distal fluke edge; smaller, fragmented white blobs on the right distal tip; dispersed white focal points across the central dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a deep vertical bounding box relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary; right lobe exhibits high-frequency, irregular peaks (5-10 pixel amplitude), while the left lobe displays lower-amplitude, more uniform serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal tips, following a broad parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular high-contrast white rings (3-8 pixel diameter) corresponding to barnacle scars, primarily localized on the right lobe and central pigmentation field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal light-colored linear disruptions visible on the left lobe surface against the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring from parasitic or epibiotic colonization; irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe indicative of minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity pixel streaks representing water droplets falling from the trailing edge of the right lobe.
